title: Golduck Is the Fastest Swimmer When It Matters
premise: Golduck is described as the fastest swimmer among Pokémon, faster than human champions, and capable of rescuing people from wrecked ships.
audiencePromise: Compare Golduck with human champions, fast-swimming fish Pokémon, stormy seas, and its own rescue work.
openLoop: Is Golduck's speed just a claim, or does it change what swimming means?
payoff: Golduck's official profile combines champion-beating speed, storm swimming, endurance, and rescue work.
engagementQuestion: Is Golduck the fastest swimmer, or the greatest rescuer?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and conversational. Stress fastest, champion, stormy, and rescue. Build from racing comparisons into survival stakes. Treat the final choice as a genuine debate.

scenes.headline: FASTEST AND A RESCUER
scenes.narration: Golduck: fastest swimmer, rescuer from wrecked ships.
scenes.caption: FASTEST SWIMMER. SHIPWRECK RESCUER.

scenes.headline: FASTER THAN ANY CHAMPION
scenes.narration: Its Pokédex entry puts it ahead of every human swimming champion.
scenes.caption: GOLDUCK > HUMAN CHAMPION

scenes.headline: FAST FISH STILL STOP
scenes.narration: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can end up completely motionless.
scenes.caption: FAST FISH: BROUGHT TO A STANDSTILL

scenes.headline: STORMS DON'T SLOW IT
scenes.narration: And it keeps swimming effortlessly through rough, stormy seas.
scenes.caption: ROUGH SEAS. STILL EFFORTLESS.

scenes.headline: IT KEEPS GOING
scenes.narration: It can even keep swimming for two days straight.
scenes.caption: TWO DAYS OF SWIMMING

scenes.headline: SPEED WITHOUT THE STRUGGLE
scenes.narration: Yet its entries stress graceful swimming, not just frightening speed.
scenes.caption: GRACEFUL, NOT JUST FAST

scenes.headline: THE ULTIMATE SWIMMER?
scenes.narration: Champion speed, storm endurance: fastest swimmer, or greatest rescuer?
scenes.caption: FASTEST SWIMMER OR GREATEST RESCUER?
